hook.line: Mariana is writing about the neighbourhood and asks Tomás for the same news in two ways, as an action and as an event. Spanish lets you say it as a verb or as a noun.
hook.en: There was a rise in the rent.

examples.es: Hubo un aumento del 10 % en los precios.
examples.en: There was a 10% rise in prices.
There was a rise in the rent.
The dollar went down this month.
There was a fall in the dollar.

rule:
The same news has two shapes.

A verb says what happened: *subir*, *bajar*, *aumentar*. *El arriendo subió.*

A noun says there was an event, after *hubo*: *un aumento*, *una subida*, *una bajada*. *Hubo una subida del arriendo.*

With the noun, *de* (or *del*) names the thing that moved: *una subida del arriendo*. A percentage goes after: *un aumento del 10 %*.

*Aumento* is masculine, *subida* and *bajada* are feminine.
smallPrint: Turning a verb into a noun like this is called nominalization. News writing loves it.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *un* or *una*: Hubo ___ subida del arriendo. Type the whole sentence.
Choose *un* or *una*: Hubo ___ aumento de las ventas. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: Hubo un aumento de las ventas.

yourTurn.prompt: Turn the noun into a verb: Hubo una subida del arriendo.
yourTurn.why: The thing that moved becomes the subject, and the noun becomes *subió*.

yourTurn.prompt: Turn the verb into a noun: El dólar bajó.
yourTurn.why: *Hubo una bajada de…* names the event and *de* names the thing.

yourTurn.prompt: There was a 10% rise in prices.
yourTurn.answer: Hubo un aumento del 10 % en los precios.
accept: Hubo un aumento del 10% en los precios.
Hubo un aumento de un 10 % en los precios.
yourTurn.why: The noun *un aumento* takes the percentage after *de* or *del*.

yourTurn.prompt: The dollar went down this month.
yourTurn.why: One verb, *bajó*, tells the whole story.

pitfalls.wrong: Hay un aumento de las ventas.
pitfalls.right: Hubo un aumento de las ventas.
pitfalls.why: Almost. For something that already happened, use *hubo*.
Almost. After a verb of change, the amount comes with *un*, not *de*.

personal: Tell us what went up or down where you live lately, either as a verb (*Subió…*) or with *Hubo una…*.
